code:
def rr(procs, quantum):
    """抢占式轮转：用完时间片就排到队尾"""
    from collections import deque
    ps = sorted(procs, key=lambda x: x[1])
    q = deque()
    remaining = {p[0]: p[2] for p in procs}
    first_run = {}
    finish = {}
    now = 0
    i = 0
    gantt = []
    while len(finish) < len(procs):
        while i < len(ps) and ps[i][1] <= now:
            q.append(ps[i][0])
            i += 1
        if not q:
            now += 1
            continue
        pid = q.popleft()
        if pid not in first_run:
            first_run[pid] = now
        run = min(quantum, remaining[pid])
        gantt.append((now, now + run, pid))
        now += run
        remaining[pid] -= run
        while i < len(ps) and ps[i][1] <= now:
            q.append(ps[i][0])
            i += 1
        if remaining[pid] > 0:
            q.append(pid)
        else:
            finish[pid] = now
    return gantt, first_run, finish


procs = [("P1", 0, 8), ("P2", 1, 4), ("P3", 2, 9), ("P4", 3, 5)]
g, fr, fin = rr(procs, 3)
print("时间片 q=3")
print("甘特图: " + " -> ".join("%s[%d,%d]" % (p, s, f) for s, f, p in g))
print("")
print("%-4s %-8s %-8s %-10s %-10s" % ("进程", "首次执行", "完成", "响应时间", "周转"))
for pid in sorted(fin):
    a = [p[1] for p in procs if p[0] == pid][0]
    print("%-4s %-8d %-8d %-10d %-10d" % (pid, fr[pid], fin[pid], fr[pid] - a, fin[pid] - a))

print("")
print("--- 时间片敏感性分析 ---")
print("%-6s %-16s %-16s" % ("q", "平均响应时间", "平均周转时间"))
for q in [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9]:
    gg, frr, ff = rr(procs, q)
    art = sum(frr[p] - [x[1] for x in procs if x[0] == p][0] for p in ff) / len(ff)
    att = sum(ff[p] - [x[1] for x in procs if x[0] == p][0] for p in ff) / len(ff)
    print("%-6d %-16.2f %-16.2f" % (q, art, att))
print("")
print("实测规律: q 越小 -> 平均响应时间越小（交互更及时），但切换次数显著增多")
print("周转时间的变化则取决于数据: 本例 q=9（接近 FCFS）时周转最小=%.2f，"
      % min(sum(rr(procs, q)[2][p] - [x[1] for x in procs if x[0] == p][0]
                for p in rr(procs, q)[2]) / len(rr(procs, q)[2]) for q in [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9]))
print("  因为长作业能连续跑完、切换开销小；但 q 过大时响应时间会恶化到 %.2f（护航效应）"
      % (sum(rr(procs, 9)[1][p] - [x[1] for x in procs if x[0] == p][0]
             for p in rr(procs, 9)[1]) / len(rr(procs, 9)[1])))
print("工程结论: q 是『响应时间』与『切换开销』的权衡，q 过大退化为 FCFS，q 过小切换开销占比过高")
